title: Sharp Hessian integrability for fully nonlinear elliptic supersolutions in low dimensions
summary: We settle the planar sharp Hessian-integrability conjecture of Armstrong, Silvestre, and Smart [\emph{Comm. Pure Appl. Math.} \textbf{65} (2012), 1169--1184] for viscosity supersolutions of fully nonlinear uniformly elliptic equations. If $κ=Λ/λ$, then the optimal exponent in the $W^{2,ε}$ regularity theory in the plane is exactly $$ ε_2(κ)=\frac{2}{κ+1}. $$ The same mechanism reaches the known upper obstruction in dimension three throughout the full range $1\le κ\le 4$ and therefore gives $$ ε_3(κ)=\frac{3}{2κ+1} \qquad(1\leκ\le4). $$ Beyond this threshold, it yields a closed algebraic…
